[size=2]
[/size][left][size=3]I finally finished this mod after almost a month! Woohoo! (˵ •̀ ᴗ •́ ˵ ) ✧ 

[color=#616161](I wanted to finish and release this mod as soon as I reached 1,000 kudos but I never made it in time... Oh, well. Either way, I'm just very glad it's done. xD )[/color]

This was so challenging to do because I'm more used to making and adding furniture, but I'm glad I did it because now I can start a chocolate farm in the game. 

As you might have noticed, I took liberties when making the cacao plants because I didn't want to waste time drawing trees. So, the cacao plants in this mod look and work the same way as the vanilla coffee beans. I've also only played around with the mod a bit because I was too excited to share it so if you encounter any bugs or typos, please let me know. :)

[color=#f9cb9c][i]As always, thank you for your support but if you'd like to extra support me, you can [url=https://ko-fi.com/orangeblossom7/goal?g=0]tip me here.[/url]﻿﻿[/i][i] ﻿˃[/i][/color][i][color=#f9cb9c]ᴗ˂ᰔᩚ[/color][/i][/size][/left][size=2][i][color=#f9cb9c]
[/color]

[/size][/font][left][font=Georgia][size=3]
This mod is all about [i][color=#f9cb9c]chocolate[/color]. [/i]It adds 2 new plants, 5 artisan machines, a number of ingredients, and chocolate recipes to the base game.[/size][/font][/left][font=Georgia]
[size=3][color=#f9cb9c]NOTES:[/color]
[list]
[*]goat milk powder and ruby chocolate syrup are currently unused in recipes
[*]machines have their own custom animation
[*]machines are [color=#b4a7d6]fairy dust[/color]-able
[*]some chocolate ingredients and recipes will be unlocked as you level up your [color=#b6d7a8]farming[/color] [color=#b6d7a8]skill[/color]
[*]some chocolates have [color=#ea9999]buffs[/color] (with some being overpowered)
[*][color=#9fc5e8]water[/color] can be bought at Pierre's General Store for 10g
[*]includes NPC [color=#d5a6bd]gift tastes[/color] (as a chocolate lover, I can't make anyone hate chocolate, so the only hated items are cacao beans, nibs, and fruits.) 
[*]not tested with other mods like automate, etc. because i don't use it
[*]no i18n compatibility yet. too lazy
[*][color=#f9cb9c]THERE'S AN OPTIONAL FILE TO MAKE THE SEEDS CRAFTABLE[/color] so get that mod as well if you want.
[/list]
[/size][size=3]For more information, either check the images, changelog, or download the PDF guide in the files tab. (I have not included the prices, but you can check it in the game if you have CJB Show Item Sell Price)
[/size]
